summary: Employee Benefit Security Administration Investigations Transparency Act or the EBSA Investigations Transparency Act This bill requires the Employee Benefit Security Administration (EBSA) of Department of Labor to annually report on cases in enforcement status, including active investigations and targeted compliance monitoring. The EBSA enforces requirements related to the protection of employee rights under employer-sponsored benefit plans (i.e., Title I of the Employee Retirement Income Security Act).
